scope: Direct calls to existing reconciliation; minimal internal input, not a validated full manifest or a live gallery integration

results.finding: Exact asset and session IDs yield matched with read-only authority.
Same display name with a different asset ID does not resolve the expected output.
Known asset integrity conflict yields conflict.
Missing session remains partially matched despite exact assets.
Different catalog digests under the same IDs both yield matched: this layer does not prove expected byte identity.
Duplicate asset IDs select the last record; conflicting duplicates require an upstream uniqueness invariant.
